nodes.summary: Variational characterization of the projection onto a cone with complete carrier: `p` is the projection of `x` iff the residual pairs nonpositively with the cone and is orthogonal to `p`. The ambient space need not be complete.
nodes.title: Variational characterization of projection onto a convex cone

nodes.summary: A point satisfying the cone variational characterization is the projection.
nodes.title: Variational characterization determines the cone projection

nodes.summary: The residual of the cone projection pairs nonpositively with every point of the cone.
nodes.title: Cone projection residual pairs nonpositively with the cone

nodes.summary: The residual of the cone projection is orthogonal to the projection.
nodes.title: Cone projection residual is orthogonal to the projection

nodes.summary: The cone projection's residual is the projection onto its negative polar. This accepts a Mathlib proper cone directly.
nodes.title: Moreau decomposition, polar form

nodes.summary: Membership in the negative polar uses the nonpositive inner-product convention.
nodes.title: Membership in the negative polar cone

nodes.summary: A point is the sum of its projections onto a proper cone and its negative polar, and the projections are orthogonal.
nodes.title: Moreau decomposition

nodes.summary: In a complete ambient space, the negative polar agrees with Mathlib's inner dual of the negated carrier.
nodes.title: Negative polar agrees with the inner dual of the negated cone

nodes.summary: The negative bipolar of a proper cone is itself, by Mathlib's inner-dual bipolar theorem.
nodes.title: Bipolar theorem for closed convex cones

nodes.summary: The negative polar is the standard dual cone of the negated set. Continuity makes its carrier closed without requiring completeness of the ambient space.
nodes.title: Negative polar cone

nodes.summary: The residual of a cone projection lies in its negative polar.
nodes.title: Cone projection residual lies in the negative polar

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
